texts.name: Daxaroth
texts.biography: Daxaroth was Dragon Queen Mutare's right paw. Some suspect that Mutare's death was really Daxaroth's plot to gain power. Nevertheless, Red and Black Dragons listen to him as if he is their new King.

specialty.name: Red Dragons
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Red Dragons or Black Dragons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
